claim_tested: WWOX product present: wild type, endogenous, in ACK1-active cancer cells
support_for: LNCaP (prostate) and MHCC-97H (liver) carry WWOX protein that is lowered or raised by the lever (steps 2a, 2b); IHC in 150 paired HCC tissues shows WWOX-positive and WWOX-negative cases
read_depth_by_me: HCC paper PMID 25738261: full text read (PDF, own copy outside the repository). Mahajan 2005 PMID 16288044: abstract plus supplementary legends only
system_and_allele: human cancer cells and tissue; wild-type WWOX
what_the_datum_is: WWOX is detectable in the lever systems; this is the only context in which the lever has been shown
what_is_unknown: whether any neural or WOREE/SCAR12-class cell has enough WWOX for a stability lever to matter; ACK1 protein in neurons (RNA only)
status: SUPPORTED in cancer cells; NO DATUM in neural cells

support_for: One observation: transcript normal, WWOX protein not detected on immunoblot in one patient's fibroblasts
read_depth_by_me: Local full text of Johannsen 2018 read in IT10 (PMID 29808465); not re-read in IT11 beyond the IT10 locator L12
what_the_datum_is: protein NOT DETECTED with transcript present; the authors offer impaired translation or premature degradation as speculation
what_is_unknown: whether the protein is made and cleared, made and insoluble, or not made; detection limit; whether a different antibody or enrichment would show a band. Not assumed in either direction here
status: UNRESOLVED; the lever is inapplicable if the protein is absent, applicable only if a band is found (R1)

support_for: P252A protein is lower than wild type and is restored by chloroquine and ammonium chloride; text states chloroquine prevented its loss under cycloheximide (supplementary Figure S4, not opened)
read_depth_by_me: Full text of PMID 41124647 read in IT10; in IT11 re-opened only to check for Q230P and ACK1 sentences (Q230P appears only in the Introduction as a WOREE variant list; ACK1 only as a restatement)
system_and_allele: human thyroid-carcinoma CAL-62, stable over-expression of P252A
what_the_datum_is: a missense in the same SDR domain as Q230P that is degraded through a lysosome-dependent route in the authors' reading
what_is_unknown: whether endogenous-level expression behaves the same; whether ACK1 or Tyr287 is involved (not tested in that paper); transfer to Q230P (not shown)
status: SUPPORTED for P252A only; no transfer to Q230P

claim_tested: Change in amount or stability by the lever: ACK1 activation lowers WWOX
support_for: Activated (constitutively active) Ack1 over-expressed in LNCaP: Wwox tyrosine-phosphorylated, rapid dissociation of the Ack1-Wwox complex, polyubiquitination, degradation; Y33F still phosphorylated and ubiquitinated; main site Tyr287; WwoxDelta5-8 not phosphorylated and not degraded; primary androgen-independent tumours: more phospho-Ack1, less Wwox
read_depth_by_me: ABSTRACT ONLY for the main text (publisher PDF blocked by a bot check; no open copy; the repository-listed open routes returned nothing readable). Supplementary Figure legends (open, figshare) read: Hsp90beta identified as Ack1 binder (kinase-dead and active GST-Ack1 pull-down), and WwoxDelta5-8 identified as an Ack1 interactor by mass spectrometry
system_and_allele: human LNCaP stable cell lines, tumours; wild-type WWOX
what_the_datum_is: the single primary source of the Tyr287 route; over-expression of a constitutively active kinase, not a physiological or inhibitor perturbation
what_is_unknown: the figures (blots, quantification, chase design, which ubiquitin chain, which ligase: IT10 review says unidentified); whether degradation is proteasomal; whether kinase-dead Ack1 was tested on Wwox level; whether an inhibitor was ever given for the Wwox endpoint
status: SUPPORTED at abstract level only; not a read

claim_tested: Change in amount by the lever: ACK1 knockdown raises WWOX
support_for: In MHCC-97H cells ACK1-shRNA raised WWOX and lowered p-ACK1, p-AKT, MMP2, MMP9 (Figure 6C); 150 paired tissues: ACK1 vs WWOX IHC score correlation r = -0.454 (Spearman)
read_depth_by_me: FULL TEXT READ (10-page PDF). The WWOX immunoblot after knockdown is shown in ONE cell line (MHCC-97H), one shRNA construct plus scrambled control; the other four lines were used for ACK1 expression only. No WWOX mRNA, no cycloheximide chase, no proteasome or lysosome inhibitor, no inhibitor drug, no re-expression, no half-life
system_and_allele: human liver-cancer cell line MHCC-97H; HCC tissues; wild-type WWOX
what_the_datum_is: steady-state WWOX protein goes up when ACK1 goes down in one HCC line; knockdown also reduces proliferation and raises apoptosis (Figure 5), so the cell state changes broadly
what_is_unknown: whether WWOX transcript changes (not measured); whether the change is post-translational; whether effect holds with a second shRNA or in a second line; effect size (blot quantification given only as P<0.01 in the legend)
status: SUPPORTED for direction, steady state, one line; stability not shown

what_the_datum_is: compounds can change WWOX or its turnover through routes other than ACK1
what_is_unknown: size of these effects on WWOX amount; not measured
